build_failures.label: neighbor-observe-v1-sta_smoke
build_failures.cause: Forced portable-atomic critical-section feature conflicted with esp-hal single-core backend; corrected in smoltcp bfb11de and actual C3 link/device tests passed.

limitations: Ethernet capture cannot locate an earlier lost ARP exchange on the radio path.
Finite queues can still lose responses at higher rates, after expiry, or under TX congestion.
Private ARP omission builds are separate from published source.
C3/S3 production DMA logic is unchanged by the final removal of unreachable legacy cfg blocks and a duplicate doc comment. Final RX and burst32 images use the listed final source hashes.

corrected_station_gate.next_check: Private echo-path-v5 traces request sequence masks at raw RX/VIF/adapter and explicit VIF/network-buffer drops, without per-packet console output.

observation_status: bounded follow-up complete; earlier isolated losses remain unexplained

notes: Masks use bit 0 for sequence 1 through bit 19 for sequence 20; 1048575 means all twenty.
RX handoff and echo masks reset before the traffic-ready marker. Header/restart metrics are cumulative.
The restart probe counts only the idle-restart helper, excluding initial and empty-list setup.
Snapshots are independently sampled counters, not transactional packet logs.
